title: Best Node Based AI Image Generators (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.tagline: · open-source node graph you run on your own GPU
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server — community servers wrap a local instance
tools.modelSupport: Any checkpoint, LoRA or custom node you install locally
tools.note: Open source and self-hosted, so the software is free and you supply the GPU. The repo moved from comfyanonymous/ComfyUI to Comfy-Org/ComfyUI; the old path still redirects.

quickstart.label: Install via the project's own CLI, exactly as the ComfyUI README shows:

tools.name: Krea
tools.tagline: · hosted generation platform with node apps and a documented REST API
tools.modelSupport: Krea’s hosted image and video models

tools.name: Flora AI
tools.tagline: · design-oriented canvas with a public technique-execution API
tools.claudeConnection: MCP and API documented by Flora at flora.ai/mcp
tools.modelSupport: Third-party image, video and text models on one canvas
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: florafauna.ai now redirects to flora.ai. Flora’s own homepage CTA is "Get started for free".

tools.name: Figma Weave
tools.tagline: · AI canvas now sold inside the Figma design suite
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server documented for Weave
tools.modelSupport: Third-party models inside the Weave canvas
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: weavy.ai redirects to weave.figma.com and the site states "Weavy is now Figma Weave." No public Weave API or developer docs are published; the trial is marked "eligible plans only".

tools.name: Freepik Spaces
tools.tagline: · browser canvas layered on a large licensed stock library
tools.claudeConnection: No first-party MCP server documented for Spaces
tools.modelSupport: Freepik’s hosted image, video and audio models
tools.note: Freepik’s own Spaces docs state a free user can create up to 3 Spaces. Checked 2026-09-01: the developer API docs at docs.freepik.com now redirect to docs.magnific.com, Freepik’s API brand.

tools.name: InvokeAI
tools.tagline: · open-source workflow editor with a strong inpainting canvas
tools.modelSupport: Any local checkpoint or LoRA you install
tools.note: Open source and self-hosted. The README installs via a downloadable launcher rather than a package-manager one-liner, so no install command is reproduced here.
